title: Anyway and Similar Words (2/2)
summaryZh: 說明 anyway 的同義用法，介紹幾個表示「儘管如此」的轉折用語。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Ask a Teacher

sentences.text: It is an adverb, too, and it means in spite of something that was said before.
sentences.zh: 它也是一個副詞，意思是儘管前面提到了某件事。

sentences.text: It is more formal and sounds a little old-fashioned when compared to anyway.
sentences.zh: 跟 anyway 比起來，它比較正式，聽起來也有點老派。

sentences.text: For example, COVID-19 infection rates are falling in my state.
sentences.zh: 舉例來說，我們州的 COVID-19 感染率正在下降。

sentences.text: Nevertheless, we should still follow the safety guidelines.
sentences.zh: 儘管如此，我們還是應該遵守安全指引。

sentences.text: Other words or expressions you may see that can serve the same purpose as anyway are anyways, nonetheless, regardless, in any case, and at any rate.
sentences.zh: 你可能還會看到其他和 anyway 功能一樣的字或說法，像是 anyways、nonetheless、regardless、in any case 和 at any rate。

sentences.text: What question do you have about American English?
sentences.zh: 你對美式英語有什麼問題嗎？

sentences.text: Send us an email at learningenglish at voanews.
sentences.zh: 請寄電子郵件給我們，地址是 learningenglish at voanews

sentences.text: com And that's Ask a Teacher.
sentences.zh: com 以上就是本集的《Ask a Teacher》。
